assumptions: Room has pale walls, light oak flooring, a black-framed window on the far wall, and no other furnishings.

Table is fixed: 180 cm along x, 90 cm along y. Initial near side is y=-45 cm; far side y=45 cm; right short side x=90 cm. Window is beyond far side. A=(45,15), B=(65,30), C=(0,0) cm on tabletop. Positions are not printed on images.
Man has short black hair, clean-shaven face, plain grey long-sleeve shirt, dark charcoal trousers and black shoes.
Wooden cup is handleless warm brown wood; porcelain cup is plain white with one handle and dark tea; tissue pack is soft blue unbranded plastic with a white dispensing opening.
Tissue pack includes one protruding white tissue; the whole pack including that tissue disappears. Background has incidental fixed wall art.

Shot 3 accepted camera is near-center with a slight right offset, distinctly more frontal than shot 2; this replaces the initially assumed near-left viewpoint. Source only requires distinct elevated views.

Scene dimensions standardized to 1672x940, approximately 16:9, following built-in output; only one-pixel dimension repairs applied. Shot 3 uses minimal camera displacement; continuous motion is retained in video prompt.
